title: Olga's Soup
text:
Olga likes soup. On Monday she makes soup with potatoes, carrots and onions. The soup is hot and good. She eats it with bread.

On Tuesday, Olga drinks tea with her friend Ivan. Ivan drinks coffee. They eat cookies. Olga likes the cookies very much.

questions.text: What does Olga make on Monday?
How does Olga probably feel about the cookies?
Why are Olga and Ivan probably friends?
options: They spend time together and share food
They work in the same shop
They never talk to each other

vocabulary.definition: a hot liquid food made by cooking vegetables or meat in water
round vegetables with brown or yellow skin that grow under the ground
a hot drink made from roasted beans
small, sweet, flat cakes that are baked

paragraph_translations: Ольга любить суп. У понеділок вона готує суп з картоплею, морквою та цибулею. Суп гарячий і смачний. Вона їсть його з хлібом.
У вівторок Ольга п'є чай зі своїм другом Іваном. Іван п'є каву. Вони їдять печиво. Ользі дуже подобається печиво.
